name: Fri. 06/11 - Maria Pistolas
description: This event features music genres such as House, R&B, Reggaeton, and Funk. It takes place at Maria Pistolas in Porto, with tickets available from €5.00.
longDescription:
The event "Fri. 06/11 - Maria Pistolas" is scheduled for Friday, November 6, 2026, at Maria Pistolas in Porto. The party starts at 11:55 PM and continues until 6:00 AM.

Attendees can expect a mix of House, R&B, Reggaeton, and Funk music. The venue is located at Praça de Dona Filipa de Lencastre 175, 4050-000 Porto, Portugal.

Tickets are available for purchase, with prices starting at €5.00 for entry without consumption. Other ticket options include €7.50 (no consumption), €10.00 (with 1 drink), €12.50 (with 1 drink), and €15.00 (with 1 drink).
